entities.summary: Zachary Joseph Miller is an American former professional football player who was a tight end in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Arizona State Sun Devils, earning consensus All-American honors in 2006. Miller was selected by the Oakland Raiders in the second round of the 2007 NFL draft. He also played in the NFL for the Seattle Seahawks, with whom he earned a Super Bowl ring in Super Bowl XLVIII over the Denver Broncos.
